task.title: How to Run ApartmentCorp Daily Rent Comp Pipeline

user_message.content:
Run the ApartmentCorp daily rent comp pipeline:
1. cd /home/ubuntu/lihtc_data and run: python3.11 find_comps_v2.py then python3.11 build_excel.py to regenerate the Excel report
2. Run python3.11 clickup_sync.py to update all 42 property tasks in the ClickUp space "Comparables of ALL Properties" (List ID: 901415479678, API key: pk_198294202_YNVG9WMPO4FUISEZC30L01PZC7S7SN1N)
3. Send the refreshed Excel file /home/ubuntu/lihtc_data/ApartmentCorp_Rent_Comp_Analysis_2026_REVISED.xlsx via Gmail MCP to both Brandon@apartmentcorp.com and Mam@22.bz with subject "Rent Comparables for all ApartmentCorp Properties — [today's date]" from Brandon@ApartmentCorp.com
